policy_version_note: Rules are concise summaries of official Google Play policy, not verbatim legal text. Always consult the linked official pages.

rules.title: Background location must be core to the app's primary function
rules.description: Apps requesting ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION must have a genuine, user-benefiting feature that requires location while the app is not in use, and must show a prominent foreground disclosure before the system dialog.
rules.policy_text_summary: Google Play restricts background location to apps whose core functionality would otherwise be impaired without it.
required_evidence: Feature that visibly needs background location
rules.assessment_logic: If background location is declared: return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless a purpose profile explicitly declares a continuous-location feature; then NEEDS_REVIEW. Return FAIL only if purpose is known AND has no location feature at all.
rules.remediation: Remove background location and use foreground-only location, or implement geofencing/foreground service alternatives. If genuinely required, prepare a Play declaration and disclosure.
rules.limitations: Manifest analysis cannot verify whether a disclosure is shown or whether the feature actually exists.

rules.title: SMS and call-log permissions restricted to default handler apps
rules.description: Permission to read/send SMS or read call logs is limited to apps that can be declared as the user's default SMS, Phone, or Caller ID app.
rules.policy_text_summary: SMS/call log permissions are permitted only for apps with core functionality requiring them and that qualify as default handlers.
rules.assessment_logic: If any SMS/call-log permission declared and purpose category is not 'messaging'/'dialer': return POTENTIAL_CONCERN (HIGH) with FAIL only when purpose is explicitly known to be non-communicational (e.g. calculator). Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
rules.remediation: Remove the permission and use the SMS Retriever API / ROLE_DIALER, or file a default-handler declaration.
rules.limitations: Whether the app qualifies as a default handler cannot be determined from the APK.

rules.title: Broad media/file access requires narrow justification
rules.description: Apps must use scoped storage, the Photo Picker, or granular media permissions; MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (all files access) is limited to apps whose core functionality truly requires it.
rules.policy_text_summary: All-files access is restricted to a narrow set of use cases such as backup, antivirus, and file managers.
rules.assessment_logic: If MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE declared: NEEDS_REVIEW with HIGH severity unless category is file_manager/backup/security, in which case POTENTIAL_CONCERN (MEDIUM).
rules.remediation: Switch to the Storage Access Framework or Photo Picker; only use all-files access where the app is genuinely a file manager or backup tool.
rules.limitations: Static analysis cannot prove whether SAF would suffice for the app's implementation.

rules.title: Permission must be necessary for the app's declared core functionality
rules.description: Every requested permission must be necessary for a feature the app clearly promotes. Requesting permissions unrelated to advertised functionality violates Play policy.
rules.policy_text_summary: Apps should only request the minimum permissions necessary for their features; unnecessary permissions may lead to rejection.
rules.assessment_logic: Compare each dangerous permission against the category's expected set. Permissions marked UNEXPECTED produce POTENTIAL_CONCERN findings. If no purpose supplied, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
rules.remediation: Remove permissions not required by the app's core features; re-request only when the user triggers the feature (runtime prompting).
rules.limitations: Without the Play Store listing, the declared purpose is user-supplied and may be inaccurate.

rules.title: Sensitive permission use must be disclosed to users
rules.description: Apps using sensitive permissions (camera, microphone, location, contacts) must clearly disclose what data is collected and how it is used, in the Play Data Safety form and in-app.
rules.policy_text_summary: Data collected via sensitive permissions must be declared in the Data Safety section and disclosed in-app before collection.
rules.assessment_logic: Always return NEEDS_REVIEW when sensitive permissions are present — the disclosure itself is outside the APK's observable scope.
rules.remediation: Add an in-app disclosure before first access and complete the Play Data Safety declaration accurately.
rules.limitations: Disclosure compliance cannot be verified from static manifest analysis.

rules.title: Background execution must respect platform limits
rules.description: Apps must not circumvent Android background restrictions (Doze, background execution limits) except for narrowly permitted foreground-service use cases.
rules.policy_text_summary: Apps must use foreground services appropriately and not abuse battery exemptions.
rules.assessment_logic: If battery-optimisation exemption requested without a genuine always-on feature in the category profile: POTENTIAL_CONCERN (MEDIUM). With boot-completed plus sensitive permissions: NEEDS_REVIEW.
rules.remediation: Use foreground services with a visible notification instead of battery exemptions.
rules.limitations: Actual background behaviour requires runtime observation.

rules.title: Ads and tracking restricted for families-directed apps
rules.description: Apps designed for families must not use the advertising ID or certain tracking permissions.
rules.policy_text_summary: Families policy limits data collection and advertising in child-directed apps.
required_evidence: Declared target audience (Play Console setting, not in APK)
rules.assessment_logic: If ad ID permission present: NEEDS_REVIEW — target audience cannot be determined from the APK.
rules.remediation: Declare target audience accurately; disable ad ID for families content.
rules.limitations: Target audience is a Play Console setting, not present in the APK.

rules.title: Package visibility and installed-app inventory must be justified
rules.description: Querying the full list of installed apps is considered sensitive and requires a core-function declaration.
rules.policy_text_summary: Apps requesting QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES must justify why narrower <queries> declarations are insufficient.
required_evidence: Core-function declaration explaining why package visibility is required
rules.assessment_logic: If declared and category not in (security, file_manager, productivity): POTENTIAL_CONCERN (HIGH); otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW.
rules.remediation: Replace with targeted <queries> declarations for the specific packages or intents needed.
rules.limitations: Legitimate use may exist beyond the known categories.
